review.feedback: The module exactly formalizes the q1=(n-1)/gcd(n-1,6) divisibility inputs: q1 | C(n,3), (n-1) | C(n^2,2), (n-1) | C((n-3)^2,2)-6, and q1 | C(n^2,(n-3)^2). The hypotheses hn:1≤n and hn:5≤n are sufficient; the n=1 case in the first theorem is degenerate (q1=0 and 0|0) but true and outside the intended n≥104 use. The names do not claim the full Q|r^3, Q∤r^2, or the 30-cofactor theorem, so no overstatement.
